algebra.title: Number Foundations
algebra.description: The real number system, order of operations, fractions, exponents and radicals — the toolkit every later topic leans on.
lessons: Order of Operations and Number Properties

algebra.title: Expressions and Polynomials
algebra.description: Working with variables: simplifying expressions, polynomial arithmetic, factoring and rational expressions.

algebra.title: Linear Equations and Inequalities
algebra.description: Solving equations by keeping them balanced, rearranging formulas, and handling inequalities and absolute values.

algebra.title: Lines and the Coordinate Plane
algebra.description: Points, distance, slope and the equations of lines and circles.
lessons: The Coordinate Plane, Distance and Midpoint

algebra.title: Systems of Equations
algebra.description: Finding where lines meet: graphing, substitution, elimination, and a first look at matrices.
lessons: Three Variables and Matrix Row Reduction

algebra.title: Quadratics and Complex Numbers
algebra.description: Every way to solve a quadratic, what the discriminant tells you, complex numbers, and the shape of parabolas.
lessons: Solving Quadratics by Factoring and Square Roots
The Quadratic Formula and the Discriminant

algebra.title: Functions
algebra.description: The central idea of the course: functions, their graphs, transformations, composition and inverses.
lessons: Reading the Graph of a Function

algebra.title: Polynomial and Rational Functions
algebra.description: End behavior, zeros and division of polynomials, then rational functions and their asymptotes.
lessons: Polynomial Division and the Remainder Theorem

algebra.title: Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
algebra.description: Growth that compounds, the number e, logarithms as the undo button, and solving exponential equations.
lessons: Exponential Functions and the Number e

algebra.title: Sequences, Series and Counting
algebra.description: Patterns that go on forever, summation notation, and the binomial theorem — a bridge to discrete math.
lessons: Arithmetic and Geometric Sequences and Series

trig.title: Angles and Radians
trig.description: Measuring rotation in degrees and radians, arc length, sector area and angular speed.
lessons: Arc Length, Sector Area and Angular Speed

trig.title: Right Triangle Trigonometry
trig.description: Sine, cosine and tangent as ratios of sides, the special triangles, and solving real triangles.
lessons: SOH CAH TOA: The Trig Ratios

trig.title: The Unit Circle
trig.description: Trig functions for any angle: the unit circle, reference angles, signs by quadrant, and all six functions.
lessons: Trig Functions on the Unit Circle

trig.title: Graphs of Trig Functions
trig.description: Waves on a graph: sine and cosine curves, amplitude, period and phase, the other four graphs, and modeling.
lessons: Graphs of Tangent and the Reciprocal Functions

trig.title: Inverse Trig Functions
trig.description: Getting angles back from ratios: arcsin, arccos, arctan, and the atan2 function every game engine uses.

trig.title: Trigonometric Identities
trig.description: The fundamental identities, proving identities, and the sum, difference, double- and half-angle formulas.

trig.title: Trigonometric Equations
trig.description: Solving equations with infinitely many solutions: general solutions, intervals, and identity-powered strategies.
lessons: Solving Equations with Identities and Multiple Angles

trig.title: Oblique Triangles
trig.description: Triangles without a right angle: the Law of Sines (and its ambiguous case), the Law of Cosines, and area.
lessons: The Law of Cosines and Triangle Area

trig.title: Vectors, Polar Coordinates and Complex Numbers
trig.description: Trig in two dimensions: vectors and components, polar coordinates, and the polar form of complex numbers.

calc1.title: Limits
calc1.description: The idea calculus is built on: what a function approaches, how to compute it, and what happens at infinity.
lessons: The Squeeze Theorem and Trig Limits
The Precise Definition of a Limit

calc1.title: Continuity
calc1.description: Functions you can draw without lifting your pen, the kinds of breaks, and the Intermediate Value Theorem.

calc1.title: The Derivative
calc1.description: Instantaneous rate of change: tangent lines, the limit definition, the derivative as a function, and rates in the real world.
lessons: Tangent Lines and the Derivative at a Point
Rates of Change: Velocity and Beyond

calc1.title: Differentiation Rules
calc1.description: Shortcuts that make derivatives fast: power, product, quotient and chain rules, implicit differentiation, and the derivatives of every elementary function.
lessons: The Power Rule and Basic Rules
Derivatives of Exponential and Logarithmic Functions

calc1.title: Derivatives in Action
calc1.description: Related rates, linear approximation, and Newton's method — derivatives solving real problems.

calc1.title: Analyzing Functions
calc1.description: What derivatives say about shape: extrema, the Mean Value Theorem, concavity, curve sketching, L'Hôpital's rule and optimization.
lessons: Derivatives and the Shape of a Graph

calc1.title: Integrals
calc1.description: Accumulation: antiderivatives, Riemann sums, the definite integral, the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus and substitution.

calc1.title: First Applications of Integrals
calc1.description: Net change, area between curves, and the average value of a function.
lessons: The Average Value of a Function

calc2.title: Applications of Integration
calc2.description: Slicing solids into disks, washers and shells, measuring curves, and computing work.
lessons: Volumes by Slicing: Disks and Washers

calc2.title: Techniques of Integration
calc2.description: The integration toolkit: by parts, trig integrals, trig substitution, partial fractions, strategy, numerical methods and improper integrals.

calc2.title: Differential Equations
calc2.description: Equations about rates of change: slope fields, Euler's method (the heart of game physics), separable equations and growth models.
lessons: Differential Equations, Slope Fields and Euler's Method

calc2.title: Parametric Equations and Polar Coordinates
calc2.description: Curves traced over time and in polar form, and how to do calculus on them.
lessons: Areas and Lengths in Polar Coordinates

calc2.title: Sequences and Series
calc2.description: Adding infinitely many numbers: sequences, series, and every major convergence test.
lessons: Absolute Convergence and the Ratio and Root Tests

calc2.title: Power Series and Taylor Series
calc2.description: Functions as infinite polynomials: power series, Taylor and Maclaurin series, and how computers really calculate sin x.

linalg.title: Vectors
linalg.description: Vectors in Rⁿ, linear combinations and span, the dot product, and the cross product — the building blocks of every position, velocity and direction in a game.
lessons: The Dot Product: Length, Angle and Projection

linalg.title: Linear Systems
linalg.description: Systems of linear equations, row reduction to echelon form, describing every solution with free variables, and the matrix equation Ax = b.
lessons: Systems of Linear Equations and Augmented Matrices
Solution Sets and Parametric Vector Form

linalg.title: Independence and Linear Transformations
linalg.description: Linear independence, functions that preserve vector arithmetic, the standard matrix of a transformation, and the rotations, scales, shears and reflections of 2D and 3D graphics.
lessons: The Matrix of a Linear Transformation

linalg.title: Matrix Algebra
linalg.description: Matrix multiplication as composition, inverses, the Invertible Matrix Theorem, and the 4×4 homogeneous matrices every game engine uses.

linalg.title: Determinants
linalg.description: Computing determinants by cofactor expansion and row reduction, their algebraic properties, and what they mean geometrically: signed area, volume and orientation.
lessons: Determinants as Area, Volume and Orientation

linalg.title: Vector Spaces
linalg.description: Abstract vector spaces and subspaces, null and column spaces, bases and dimension, rank, and changing coordinates between bases.

linalg.title: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
linalg.description: Directions a matrix only stretches, the characteristic equation, diagonalization, and long-run behavior of dynamical systems and Markov chains.

linalg.title: Orthogonality and Least Squares
linalg.description: Orthogonal sets and projections, Gram–Schmidt and QR, least-squares fitting, and symmetric matrices and the singular value decomposition.
